scenes.title: One trade, in R
head: Value
scenes.say: R is what a trade made, divided by what you risked. Risk forty, make eighty: that's plus two R.

scenes.text: R lets you compare every trade, whatever the size.
scenes.say: R lets you compare every trade, whatever the size, the market or the account.

scenes.title: Your journal does the maths.
scenes.say: Type entry, stop and exit. The R appears as you type.
